name: Fortune Seeker’s Mirror
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 7th; Slot —; Price 8,800 gp; Weight .5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This fist-sized piece of magically-treated obsidian functions as a normal mirror and allows its bearer to cast divination spells at a +1 caster level. Additionally, once per day, a creature can stare at its surface for 10 minutes and then pose one question aloud.

The answer to the question appears in common, written across the surface of the mirror as though the questioner had cast divination.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells divination; Cost 4,400 gp
